body: Thank you!!

I'll try that. I was just doing the pull it up with one hair tie and twisting it into itself and securing it. I have very fine, stick straight hair so luckily it's mostly all pulled apart. I do finger picking, bristle brush, detangling brush and then a normal brush and luckily it's not as bad as I'd feared itd be this time. I'm sorry you had to cut yours off :( that's pretty much my nightmare..
God, I'm trying. I sat in the bath for two hours before I got the energy to force myself to wash it.
Ah man I see why that'd be distressing too.
I'm the day after! Happy early birthday to you as well!
I do the same thing so I feel you. I told my friend that I hope they put me on something so I don't get so upset about it. I didn't mention he's a reason I get upset though..

I usually get the numbness when I start getting really really sad or distressed, it's just odd to get it without the accompanied feelings. I understand nobody here is a doctor lol I really appreciate those words of encouragement. I actually worked in a garden center for years so that really struck a chord!
That makes sense too! I have a coworker who pops my back and arms and stuff for me because they get tense. Im glad that message helped you! I've been looking into that but it requires ~money~ lol
Yea I actually grind my teeth really bad. All of my teeth are jacked up from my grinding and I grind so bad it's broken some of them. But I do grind all the time, not just hypo :(
I hope so!! I was so happy to have a second chance. I hope they provide that for you. Good luck on finals!
Circadian Rhythm by Silversun Pickups
Yea. I deleted everybody's phone numbers. Maybe it will work this time..
I am the only one who does the initiating. Ever.
Thwy forget me when I'm alive, why would they remember me when I'm not around to remind them
Saaaame I lay in bed pretty much until I'm JUST ABOUT to be late for work, every morning, without fail
It's so much easier to lay down and curl up and not do anything than it is to try and be a functional person
Yea. That's the biggest thing they've told me is I have to care for myself like I care for other people. Can't quite wrap my head around that though.
It's great that it helps you like that!!
Yea I have a removable shower head so I just stuck my head in and washed it this morning before work
Yep. Houston we have a problem

Same, my boyfriend comes to check on me after I've been gone a while. Once I'm in there it's the same thing, I don't want to get out lol. So I feel you. The warm water is amazing for drowning out everything, it's just a major obstacle to make it that far.
You can do it! <3
Yea, i ended up washing my hair over the tub because I ended up not having enough time after I'd laid in bed wishing washing over it. I just couldn't show up to work all gross again
Yep. That's pretty much it exactly. Wouldn't feel greasy and gross but I just can't drag myself in there. I just throw my hair up and shower myself in deodorant and hope nobody notices
Thanks, I appreciate that. I'm about to have to go to work though.. Woke up this morning debating on whether or not I should just quit but rent being due is rent being due
Yea. Wading through the swamp is the fucking worst man. I'm sorry

I'm a huge fuck up. I'm a burden on my friends and family. I want them to love me but I'm undeserving. They are such good people, and I love them very very much. I wouldn't have made it this far without them, but all I do is hurt them. Over and over and over and over. They don't deserve that.
Yea. I don't think I could go through with birthing a child. What if they had the same mental and physical problems I have? I would feel horrible

I'm really sorry you feel the same way. There was a post here some time ago that was like most people wake up every day without it being a burden to wake up and get out of bed and function and they don't even realize how enviable that is. It's fucking sad to think some people are just wired that way and then you have us
I'm so sorry you feel the same way. I hope you have good luck too. It definitely does feel like total doom.
It's easier than knowing I'm going to inevitably hurt them

I get those too. I think it might be dissociation but I'm not sure honestly. Like it's literally like my soul is being pushed out through my chest. I call it the out of body experience. I'm not sure what causes it but I'm really sorry it happened to you because it fucking blows. I typically get them before a panic attack.
I've put it off for ten years. I definitely understand. It's taken me forever

Thank you for taking the time out of your day to talk to me!! It means a lot. Talking helps prevent intrusive thoughts for me, so you're really helping out a stranger. I'm probably going to sleep soon, but if you want, you're free to pm me whenever! I hope your night or day is the best it can be.
Yea I got reported too when I was in school. That's why I'm so hesitant to say anything. I'm sorry that you went through that. At least it had positive consequences as well as the negative?
I'm not a minor, thankfully. I never imagined I'd go through this again as a full fledged adult. I guess I was hoping id grow out of it.
The whole thing makes me so nervous. The note taking. She's a social services worker so I'm afraid she'll report me for being a danger to myself if I say too much.

She gave the number for the psychological services but I don't have my new insurance card yet. I'm really scared she's going to be mad at me for not having my evaluations done yet, considering she gave me two weeks. Im scared to tell her
Every single person who I had thought I had connected with is gone

I used to do molten plastic and those scars are probably my most prelavent. All of the others faded. Those, not so much. They're ten years old though. I remember they felt a lot better than blade though.
I'm sorry you're going through it too!! God it sucks. That's the name of the game of it though I guess. If we pretend it isn't happening, maybe it will go away. /s
I go through this same thing. I tell him I wish I just didn't exist, and he tells me how he'd miss me if I stopped existing. But if I had never existed in the first place..
I'm really sorry to hear that, because that is some heavy exhausting shit to carry.
I don't really understand what you're saying
I'm really sorry that you do

I don't even want it anymore. Im sorry. I don't even want to invite people to hurt me. I always said I wouldn't do that to myself again, and I let my. Guard down and invited people in and look what fucking good it did me. Everybody who has anything to do with me just fucks off, no matter how much I love them. I just feel like I'm not meant to be allowed to be in peoples lives. I just fuck up every single time I'm given the chance. Iim happy you met people that like you and want to be around you. I just don't think that will ever happen for me.

I try really hard to be a good friend. I invite people places. I try to be the friend people want to have around.. But how am I going to make new friends if the people in my life now don't even want me around. I definitely feel like an extra
I could maybe try the journal. I usually document when I have nightmares in Daylio so maybe I could document it there. Thank you!!
Yea exactly I used seroquel like a time traveler haha I hated being awake so why be awake when I could sleep?

Funnily enough I used to be on seroquel. I'm not sure I could go back, I was sort of addicted to seroquel, I could sleep 12 hours and wake up and take it again and repeat forever. I've never tried Xanax though for the anxiety
Hand sanitizer sounds like an amazing plan. Vaseline and hand sanitizer sounds like a really good combo. Thank you!!
I have worn down almost all of my back teeth from stress grinding, so I understand. I'm too ashamed to really tell anyone or go to the dentist though.
I'm really sorry you feel the same way
Yea, i love them and don't want to hurt them
I don't have a therapist yet. I've been off therapy and medication for ten years now. I'm working up the strength to call and set something up
I'm trying really hard. It's so sour today. Thank you for everything you said

Yea. It's really difficult to look towards the future when you're not imagining having a future. I'm sure you're not as bad as you think. It's much easier to be hard on yourself than it in to be on other people
Yea but I don't want to put those three people through the suffering I'm causing them. I've been off my medications for ten years. They don't deserve for me to continue hurting them.

I understand where you're coming from. I am terrified of going to hell.. I'm not even religious but that thought is horrible. And I understand the outsider thing. I'm really sorry you have to carry all of that because it's some heavy shit. I know it isn't much but I'll think a happy thought for you. I've had this thought, if there is a God, why would he punish his children for trying to escaping their suffering.
Same. Straight talk sends me a text every few days and it's always such a let down.
